# docs/templates/

Reusable document templates for recurring project deliverables.

Store blank or lightly pre-formatted Markdown, Word, or PDF frameworks here that can be copied and filled in for each stage of the course. This folder is the single source of truth for document structure — if you find yourself reformatting a report header or memo section more than once, extract the skeleton into a template here. Examples include a standard executive-memo template (company, date, subject, recommendation, supporting analysis), a stage-report cover page, and a peer-comparison table shell. Prefix each file with a short descriptor, e.g. `template-exec-memo.md` or `template-stage-report.docx`.
